en.title: One family, four expiry dates
en.subtitle: The earliest date decides the trip
en.note: Kids' passports last 5 years, not 10. Schengen wants 3 months left after you leave.
en.focal: Check every passport the day you book
en.alt: Diagram of one family's four passport expiry dates in order: child 2 valid to 2027, child 1 to 2028, mum to 2030, dad to 2032; the earliest date decides the trip, kids' passports last 5 years not 10, and Schengen wants 3 months left after you leave
en.caption: Four passports, four clocks - and the shortest one sets the family's real deadline.
